command: set -euo pipefail; apk_path=$(adb shell pm path link.localclimate.app | head -n 1 | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^package://'); test -n "$apk_path"; adb pull "$apk_path" /tmp/lcl-v49-installed.apk >/dev/null; unzip -p /tmp/lcl-v49-installed.apk 'assets/public/assets/*.js' | grep -Fq 'plain-shelly-runtime'; adb shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=' | head -n 2; adb shell pidof link.localclimate.app; adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m 1 'link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity'; ! adb logcat -d -v brief '*:E' | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in link.localclimate.app'; git rev-parse HEAD; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/plug-screen-automation-entry-20260917)"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
